# CMS renderer samples

These HTML and JSON files and selected manifest entries are copied from the local
CMS `tools:blocks:export` output (`src/var/tmp`, 2026-11-09). They represent the
built-in button, text-heading and pricing-table renderers, without a running CMS.
They are sample output, not a complete enumeration of supported markup.
HTML snapshots preserve renderer whitespace verbatim; `.gitattributes` excludes
these raw snapshots from whitespace-error checks.
